White House Press Ban Sparks Lawsuits, Media Boycott

Several news networks, including CNN, MS NOW, and POLITICO, have filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration to restore their access to the White House, citing First Amendment rights. This action follows the White House's decision to ban these networks from press briefings and pool coverage. In response to the ban on CNN, other news networks have refused to provide pool coverage of the White House. The White House has also launched a 24/7 presidential streaming app, referred to as 'Trump TV', amid the ongoing media ban and feud with the press.
